# Sailor Pen

> Sailor Pen is a Japanese luxury writing instrument manufacturer offering fountain pens, ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils, and premium inks with traditional craftsmanship.

Sailor Pen specializes in high-quality writing instruments featuring Japanese artisanal techniques including maki-e lacquer work and traditional design. The company offers an extensive product catalog ranging from professional-grade pens to collectible luxury items, complemented by a comprehensive support ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Fountain Pens
- Ballpoint Pens
- Mechanical Pencils
- Premium Inks
- Japanese Craftsmanship
- Maki-e Lacquer Arts
- SHIKIORI Collection
- PROFESSIONALGEAR

## Products & Collections

- [PRODUCTS](https://en.sailor.co.jp/product-top): Main product catalog page featuring fountain pens, ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils
- [Fountain Pen](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/fountain-pen): Fountain pen product catalog featuring Galaxy Series 1911 and luxury collections
- [Ballpoint Pen](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/ball-point-pen): Ballpoint pen product catalog featuring TUZU Forge and SHIKIORI collections
- [Mechanical Pencil](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/mechanical-pencil): Mechanical pencil product category featuring PROFESSIONALGEAR Gold models
- [Multi-Function Pen](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/multifunctional-pencil): Multi-function pen catalog with 1911 4-in-1 and PROFESSIONALGEAR IMPERIAL BLACK
- [Dip Pen & Dip Pen Ink](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/dip-pen): Dip pen products including hocoro and Dipton with specialty inks
- [Traditional Lacquer Arts](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/traditional-lacquer-arts): Traditional lacquer arts fountain pens including Wabi Sabi Kiwami collection

## Inks & Consumables

- [Ink](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/ink): Fountain pen ink products including Teatime Around the World collection
- [Consumable Goods](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/consumable-goods): Consumable goods including SHIKIORI and MANYO INK fountain pen supplies
- [Ballpoint Pen Refill](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/ballpoint-pen-refill): Ballpoint pen refill products including Refill 0700 consumables
- [Other Consumable](https://en.sailor.co.jp/category_product/other-consumable-consumable-goods): Pen accessories and consumables including ink converters and refill products
